_: What's kept of a page's address (CONTRACT step 3, for metadata): scheme, host and path only; userinfo, query, fragment and control characters dropped; the rest redacted as text and cut to 2048 characters. An address with no scheme://host form (data:, javascript:, blob:, about:, malformed) is null: it can carry the page itself. Null when nothing is left. Every implementation gives these answers.

cases.name: a combining mark after ? or # still ends the address there
a combining mark after @ still drops the userinfo
a host with a port kept
an email in the path redacted
a home folder in a file URL redacted
a data: address carries the page: none of it kept
a javascript: address: none of it kept
a blob: address: none of it kept
about:blank, and anything with no host: none of it kept
data:// with slashes still carries the page: none of it kept
javascript://, in any case: none of it kept
about://, blob://: none of it kept
a local file keeps its path, redacted
